rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for an animal, especially a dog, making a barking sound.

example.english: I can hear the dog next door bark all night.
example.traditional: 我成晚都聽到隔籬隻狗吠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 teng1 dou2 gaak3 lei4 zek3 gau2 fai6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the outer covering of a tree or woody plant.

example.english: The bark of this tree is very rough.
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 syu6 ge3 syu6 pei4 hou2 cou1 cou3

rows.note: Use this everyday noun phrase for the barking sound of a dog rather than for the tree covering.

example.english: The bark from the dogs next door is so loud that I can't sleep.
example.traditional: 隔離屋啲狗叫聲嘈到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 uk1 di1 gau2 giu3 seng1 cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3

rows.note: Use this for sharp, forceful speech, especially when someone shouts an order.

example.english: They bark at me to stop moving.
example.traditional: 佢成日喝住我，叫我唔好郁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hot3 zyu6 ngo5 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 juk1
